about: Which ForgeVisual sight (Data/sights.json) each heavy weapon model wears (ForgeVisual GunSights, embedded). at is where the middle of the sight's base stands, in the model's export frame (front -Z, metres, model size): on the highest part of the gun under the base, the line through the window clear of the gun from 0.3 m behind it. replace names the model's own sight parts it takes the place of.

heavy-mg.about: holographic 1x: the wide window finds targets fast while the machine gun sweeps; in place of the download's reflex sight

anti-materiel-rifle.about: 2x prism scope: the precision rifle shoots far; its aim had a sniper's zoom behind an open reflex sight

grenade-launcher.about: red dot 1x: small, keeps the drum and tube in view for lobbed shots; in place of the download's reflex sight (1.4 cm back, where the top tube carries the whole base)

recoilless.about: red dot 1x on the top block: the tube had no optic and its SightLook floated 7 cm left of the tube, so aiming looked past the tube's edge at nothing

tracking-rifle.about: holographic 1x: the homing rifle locks on, it needs a wide view more than magnification
